results.name: Python - input()
results.description:
#### Feed the python!

Get the password in the .passwd file by exploiting a vulnerability in this python script.

### Source code
---
```py
#!/usr/bin/python2
 
import sys
 
def youLose():
    print "Try again ;-)"
    sys.exit(1)
 
 
try:
    p = input("Please enter password : ")
except:
    youLose()
 
 
with open(".passwd") as f:
    passwd = f.readline().strip()
    try:
        if (p == int(passwd)):
            print "Well done ! You can validate with this password !"
    except:
        youLose()
```
---

```
Protocol	SSH
Port	2222
```

#### Always quote your vars 😉

Bypass this script’s security to recover the validation password.

### Source code
---
```bash
#!/bin/bash
 
#PATH=$(/usr/bin/getconf PATH || /bin/kill $$)
PATH="/bin:/usr/bin"
 
PASS=$(cat .passwd)
 
if test -z "${1}"; then
    echo "USAGE : $0 [password]"
    exit 1
fi
 
if test $PASS -eq ${1} 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Well done you can validate the challenge with : $PASS"
else
    echo "Try again ,-)"
fi
 
exit 0
```
